lua: T = require('lib.testkit'); S = require('lib.state'); C = require('lib.camera'); W = require('lib.world'); PUT = function(x, z, yaw) local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z, p.face = x, z, yaw; p.walk_to = nil; p.walk_path = nil; nova.named('van'):teleport(x + 300, z + 300, 0); C.reset(yaw) end; BETWEEN = function(who, d) local p = nova.named('postmaster'); local e = C.state.eye; local dx, dz = e[1] - p.x, e[3] - p.z; local l = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz); local x, z = p.x + dx / l * d, p.z + dz / l * d; if who == 'van' then nova.named('van'):teleport(x, z, 1.57) else local h = nova.named('hazel'); h.x, h.z = x, z; h.mode = 'work'; h.work_at = { x, z }; h.home = { x, z } end end

route.lua: local c, s = math.cos(-2.29), math.sin(-2.29); local lx, lz = 5.0, 1.0; PUT(162 + lx * c + lz * s, 54 - lx * s + lz * c, 0)
